user.title: Connect your HDMI matrix
user.description: For compatible 8×8 models using HTTP video.set and all_dat.get. Setup does not switch outputs. Routing reports are checked every 15 seconds. No reliable power feedback was found over HTTP, so the Power sensor stays unknown; use the Power on and Power off buttons.

error.invalid_sources: Give each input a different, non-empty name.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without a scheme, a port, or a path.

abort.already_configured: This matrix is already set up in No Hassle AV.
